dream.text: At New York night four bodies converged toward the western portal. The greeter opened palms to welcome arrivals; the pilgrim kept slow, steady westward steps; the wanderer closed the arc, listening for small motion; the watcher held a wide sweep. Small routines—look, walk, wait—repeated until sleep stitched the day into one gentle playout.
